quest.description: A reliquary sunk beneath the hills, flooded once and drained badly. Two doors, one treasury, and everything between them still on guard duty. A through-road for the brave and a payday for the quick.

0,1.description: The north door of the vault hangs off one hinge, green water-stains marking how high the flood once reached.

1,1.description: A drowned antechamber. The floor tiles have settled unevenly, and some of them settle further when stepped on.

2,0.description: The west strongroom, its shelves collapsed into a silt-bedded heap that might still hide what the flood could not carry away.

2,1.description: The vault's crossing hall, four archways under a cracked dome. Wet footprints that are not yours end in the middle of the floor.

2,2.description: The east reliquary. On a stone table, in plain sight, sits the vault's great seal — and its last clerk still at his post.

3,1.description: The counting room. Tally-marks cover every wall, and the counting has not stopped.

4,1.description: The south door, half-buried outside but clear within — the vault's back way, known to smugglers and worse.

characters.name: Vault Skeleton
characters.description: A guard who never abandoned the crossing hall. Its halberd has rusted to lace; its grip has not.

characters.name: Reliquary Skeleton
characters.description: The vault's last clerk, seated at its table, quill long gone. It rises only when something touches the seal.

characters.name: Vault Mage
characters.description: The warden of the counting room, still tallying in the dark. Interruptions are deducted.

items.name: The Vault Seal
items.description: A palm-sized disc of lead and silver, the sigil of the drowned order. Whoever holds it may claim what the vault held.

items.name: Grave Aegis
items.description: A round shield of blackened bronze, flood-pitted but sound. It turns a blade a finger's width better than bare mail.

items.name: Steel Falchion
items.description: A broad, forward-weighted blade from the strongroom racks, still bright under a decade of silt.

items.name: Potion of Healing
items.description: A small vial of red liquid that restores health.

objective.description: Claim the Vault Seal from the east reliquary.
